snippet.title: This Basketball Net Installs Itself! 🤯 #basketball
snippet.description:
This is one of the most genius inventions in basketball. When players show up to a court with no net on the hoop, instead of playing without one, they use this removable net. You simply throw it onto the rim along with the ball and it locks itself in place automatically. It looks completely impossible to remove once it's on, but all you have to do is throw the ball the opposite way and it pops right off.
